rationale.condition_agreement: The hypothesis specifies simulations for temperatures between 300 and 1200 K on pristine, defect-free samples, while the target uses atomistic simulation (Monte Carlo and non-equilibrium molecular dynamics) with a single-phase bcc constraint in a room to high-temperature regime. The main regime (atomistic simulation, moderate to high temperatures) aligns, though the hypothesis emphasizes a specific temperature range and defect-free condition more explicitly.
